item.title: Electron Microscopy Studio 2.1.1
item.description:
Features
* a large image's open shows its stage and time and can be stopped (#752) (9b8dbf5)
Bug Fixes
* deps: a second EELS Align no longer holds an extra copy of the file, and Auto ID offers what it nearly found (#757) (3836625) * export and session sheets open on the window that asked, and one window's export no longer blocks another (#751) (327f0d3) * exported files name Electron Microscopy Studio as their writer (#765) (9c6f697) * File > Open with every window minimised opens no second, empty window (#763) (2f1c3c4) * refuse an image export above 16384 px from its size, before the full-size copy (#750) (a946517) * the website download is named Electron Microscopy Studio, its app and DMG files included (#760) (b3aa3f4)
